changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwmedicationcategoriesclass AS SELECT mcc.id, mcc.medication_category_id, mcc.name FROM public.medication_categories_class mcc;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwmedicationcategoriesclass TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwmedicationcategoriesclass FROM report_user;
